mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the GDP growth condition is met, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production by more than 1% in a month indicates supply chain disruptions, which can lead to reduced output and higher costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% month-over-month, the combination signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over two consecutive months signals a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the housing starts increase condition is met, or if the correlation between housing starts and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the consumer price index increases by less than 0.1%, it signals strong consumer demand without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and CPIAUCSL increase < 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of RSAFS increase and low CPIAUCSL increase on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
